basis.shell: execute commands in the role sandboxes (runner.sqlite3, ACP tool events), first real command event to completion, excluding ht-resource wait/status/stop and ht-role calls
basis.jobs: local-compute jobs (world.sqlite3, resources events), first running state to the terminal state; job_cpu_s is the scheduler's container CPU seconds

result.scale: 1-10 (Estimated Score, calibrated to the ICLR scale by the service)

system.name: researchworld
system.description: HuTian ResearchWorld 4.5.0, this project's own install (images :rwe-v4.5.0)

agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one agent per role through acpx's ACP adapter in the role's sandbox container

network.search: the shared search tool (MCP server rwe-search in every sandbox) through the same shield
network.web_access: every request of every role through the run's shield proxy, HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy with the shield's CA: the same URL, keyword, id and date rules as the other systems, the shield logs each URL; no direct way out, server-side search and remote tools off (Issue #73)

tools.permissions: acpx --approve-all --non-interactive-permissions fail: every tool call the agent asks for is approved; the role's sandbox container is the boundary

preinstalled.zh: HuTian 的 system image researchworld:rwe-v4.5.0 和 worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.5.0（acpx 与各 agent 的 ACP 适配、researchworld 包的 Python、Node.js）
preinstalled.en: HuTian's system image researchworld:rwe-v4.5.0 and worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.5.0 (acpx and each agent's ACP adapter, Python with the researchworld packages, Node.js)

reasons.resources.cpus: world.json sets no resources: each role's sandbox gets HuTian's defaults
